topic: Workflow actor tiering/pinning does not propagate into the allocator RuntimeRequest (phase-decompose dispatch)
notes:
PROBLEM
Workflow-dispatched actors (durable executors, ensemble/team members, agent-dispatched scouts) ignore their brofile's `runtime.tier` and the brofile static `provider`. The allocator receives a tier-less request and free-selects across all providers, landing on whatever wins a tiebreak (observed: brodex/gpt-5.5 for durable executors, claude-opus-4-8 for scouts). The intended design (operator): workflow actors are TIERED (not statically pinned); first dispatch resolves a lane from the allocator and the lease pins it for the durable actor's remaining life. Scouts are the one legitimate hard-pin (claude scouts underperform → must be gpt) and should use `runtime.pin`, NOT a static `provider` (which the allocator ignores).

EVIDENCE (allocator trace, ~2026-05-31T02:55Z)
- Durable executor request reached allocator as `{ "tier_mode": "exact", "durable": true }` — NO tier.
- All 6 candidate lanes (brodex, claude-opus-4-8, codex, copilot, deepseek, gemini) scored identically 0.2 (tier_fit 0.8, provider_preference 0.5, quota 0.5). brodex won the tiebreak.
- Lease evidence per run: scouts(non-durable) -> claude/opus-4-8; durable executors -> brodex/gpt-5.5. Neither is the intended lane.
- Prior run with corpus-pathfinder brofile set to runtime.tier=standard DID resolve to claude/sonnet-4-6 (the standard-tier Claude entry) — proving brofile.runtime.tier CAN reach the agent-dispatch allocation, and that the allocator only honors tier/pin, never the brofile static provider.

ROOT-CAUSE TRACE (grounded)
- src/workflow/engine/actor_nodes.rs:52 -> runtime_for_actor(actor).
- src/workflow/engine.rs:719-734 runtime_for_actor: durable actor with no actor.runtime synthesizes a BARE RuntimeRequest {durable:true} (no tier/pin). Tier must come from the brofile.
- src/server/workflow_runtime.rs:112-116: reads brofile_runtime via resolve_exec_brofile_for_allocator(brofile) and merge_runtime_request(brofile_runtime, actor_runtime). For a SINGLE executor this should carry brofile.runtime.tier; for TEAM members resolve_exec_brofile_for_allocator (src/tools/dispatch.rs:1660-1676) resolves the member brofile via the team selector. The trace shows the durable (panel/ensemble) request has no tier, so the brofile.runtime.tier is dropped on the ensemble/team-member dispatch path (and possibly the single-executor path — inlet lease was brodex; not definitively isolated).
- src/tools/dispatch.rs:248-269: when allocation_request is Some, request.provider = selected.lane.provider OVERRIDES the brofile-resolved provider. Correct under tiering, but with no tier the selection is a free-for-all.
- src/orchestration/allocator.rs:1217-1228 fallback_lane: no pin/pool -> Provider::Codex hard fallback; the observed brodex comes from the active candidate set, not built_in_config (built_in_config has no brodex) — there is an allocator candidate source (pool/config) that includes brodex+copilot not present in built_in_config(); active config source not yet located.

DISPATCH PATHS (each handles brofile.runtime differently — needs isolation)
1. agent dispatch (corpus-pathfinder scouts via bro_agent_dispatch). brofile.runtime.tier observed to propagate (standard->sonnet). Static provider ignored.
2. single executor (workflow_dispatch_executor: inlet, facilitator at SynthesizeDag). Should merge brofile.runtime; inlet observed brodex — unconfirmed whether tier reached it.
3. ensemble/team member (panel architecture/implementation/risk via team broadcast). Trace shows tier dropped here.

WHAT WAS DONE THIS SESSION (commit 6ae3437)
- Converted 12 phase-decompose brofiles to runtime.tier (premium for reasoning/edit roles, standard for advisor); reverted corpus-pathfinder to static codex/gpt-5.5 (WRONG mechanism — allocator ignores static provider). The tiering half is INERT for the workflow paths that drop the tier. The guard half (normalize-dag-measurements.py) is real and validated.

OPEN QUESTIONS / NEXT STEPS
- Read the ensemble/team-member dispatch path and the single-executor allocation path to pinpoint exactly where brofile.runtime is dropped before the RuntimeRequest is built.
- Locate the active allocator candidate config (source of brodex/copilot lanes not in built_in_config) — custom config/pool.
- Decide real fix: (a) ensure each dispatch path threads brofile.runtime (tier/pin) into the allocation request; and/or (b) seed pin from brofile provider/model for durable actors; (c) scout should use runtime.pin (provider=codex, model=gpt-5.5) not static provider.
- Separately: whether teams snapshot member brofile config at create time (bro_team create) vs resolve live — affects whether re-installing member brofiles takes effect.

RELATED
- Mechanical DAG-synthesis guards (normalize-dag-measurements.py) shipped in 6ae3437 and validated independently — orthogonal to this issue.
- Facilitator model-swap no-op was the same root cause: durable executor free-selects brodex/gpt-5.5 regardless of brofile model. All three "model" runs were actually gpt-5.5/brodex.

CODE-TRACE VERIFICATION (worktree fix/workflow-actor-tiering @ 4b6ec2a, 2026-05-30)

Three findings, all grounded in code reads:

FINDING 1 — executor/ensemble tier drop is NOT a code bug (operational stale-state).
- workflow_dispatch_executor (src/server/workflow_runtime.rs:111-116) DOES merge brofile_runtime: `merge_runtime_request(brofile_runtime, actor_runtime)`. base=brofile (tier), overlay=actor ({durable:true}, no tier). apply_runtime_overlay (allocator.rs:546-557) only overwrites tier when overlay.tier.is_some() — so brofile tier is PRESERVED. durable=true is OR-ed in.
- The ensemble path (ensemble_nodes.rs:50-59 -> workflow_dispatch_ensemble -> per-member workflow_dispatch_executor) goes through the SAME merge with the member brofile. Tier preserved there too.
- The merged runtime is passed straight to allocator::allocate (dispatch.rs:248-264). Tier is used.
- This merge block has existed since commit e4ebfe8 (2026-05-14), two weeks before the trace.
- Installed brofiles NOW carry runtime.tier (verified ~/.local/state/blackbox/bro/brofiles/phase-decomposer-{inlet,architecture}.json = tier:premium). The no-tier trace at 2026-05-31T02:55Z (=20:55 local) was 6 min after the source commit 6ae3437 (20:49) — daemon was running stale brofiles / not yet reinstalled+restarted. RESOLUTION: reinstall the 12 phase-decompose brofiles + restart daemon, then re-trace; premium should resolve to a premium-tier lane.

FINDING 2 — scout free-select IS a real bug (confirmed root cause).
- corpus-pathfinder.json (installed) has static provider:codex/model:gpt-5.5 and NO runtime block.
- Agent-dispatch path (src/tools/agents.rs:869-884): runtime = bf.runtime(None) -> merge manifest.runtime -> merge runtime_override. Then because the scout agent returns strict JSON (output schema), `with_derived_capability(runtime, StructuredOutput)` is called. with_derived_capability (allocator.rs:1464-1475) does `get_or_insert_with(RuntimeRequest::default)` — so None becomes Some(RuntimeRequest{derived_capabilities:[StructuredOutput], tier:None, pin:None}).
- That makes allocation_request Some -> dispatch_fresh_bro_task runs the allocator -> free-selects -> OVERRIDES the static provider:codex (dispatch.rs:269 request.provider = selected.lane.provider) -> lands on claude-opus-4-8 (observed).
- This is a GENERAL footgun: ANY brofile with a static provider + output schema gets its provider silently overridden by free-select. Not scout-specific.
- Fix per operator design: corpus-pathfinder uses runtime.pin{provider:codex, model:gpt-5.5, effort:medium, authority:operator}. Pin filters providers to codex (resolve_provider_pool allocator.rs:1121-1122) and untiered_lane sets model=gpt-5.5 (allocator.rs:1203-1212). Optional broader code fix: seed pin from brofile static provider when allocation_request is forced Some solely by a derived capability.

FINDING 3 — brodex/copilot candidate source LOCATED.
- Both allocator overlay configs are ABSENT (~/.local/state/blackbox/bro/allocator.json and <project>/.bro/allocator.json). load_effective_config (allocator.rs:491-502) returns only built_in_config, which has NO brodex/copilot in any tier or pool.
- The candidates come from resolve_provider_pool (allocator.rs:1101-1102): `let mut providers = Provider::ALL.iter().copied().collect()`. With no pool and no pin, the candidate set is the ENTIRE Provider enum (incl. Brodex, Copilot). Tier-less => all score identically => tiebreak picks brodex. A tier=premium request narrows scoring via tier_fit (premium tier = Claude/Codex/Glm/Deepseek/Gemini; brodex/copilot are not premium-mapped).

FIX IMPLEMENTED (worktree fix/workflow-actor-tiering, branched from main@4b6ec2a)

Operator chose: config fix + general code fix.

1. CONFIG (Finding 2): system-defaults/brofiles/phase-decompose/corpus-pathfinder.json v3->v4 — added runtime.pin{provider:codex, model:gpt-5.5, effort:medium, authority:operator}. Kept static provider/model (provider is a required Brofile field). JSON validated.

2. CODE (general footgun): src/orchestration/allocator.rs
   - New RuntimeRequest::expresses_selection_intent() — true iff the request carries tier/tier_ladder/min_tier/max_tier/pool/pin/prefer/selection_policy or explicit capabilities. durable flag and derived_capabilities alone => inert (no provider preference).
   - New pin_static_provider_if_inert(runtime, provider, model, effort): when the request is inert, seeds an artifact-authority pin from the brofile's static provider/model/effort so the allocator honors the declared provider instead of free-selecting across Provider::ALL. No-op when intent is present or runtime is None.
   - Applied in src/tools/agents.rs bro_agent_dispatch, immediately after the with_derived_capability(StructuredOutput) block, using the resolved provider + exec_opts model/effort.
   This closes the class: ANY static-provider brofile that returns structured output (or is durable with no tier) now honors its provider rather than being silently overridden.

VALIDATION: cargo test --lib allocator:: (22 passed, incl. 2 new: pin_static_provider_seeds_pin_for_inert_request, pin_static_provider_noop_when_request_has_selection_intent), bro_agent_dispatch (17 passed), cargo clippy --lib clean.

REMAINING / NOT DONE (operational, needs operator):
- Reinstall the 12 phase-decompose brofiles + corpus-pathfinder v4 into the daemon store and restart blackboxd-dev so the running daemon picks up runtime.tier (Finding 1) and the new pin. Not done — shared-service mutation needs approval.
- Build/install the new blackboxd binary from this branch for the code fix to take effect at runtime.
- Re-run the phase-decompose allocator trace after reinstall+restart to confirm: durable executors resolve premium-tier lane; scouts resolve codex/gpt-5.5; no brodex free-select.
- Branch not yet merged/committed — changes live in worktree only.

Note: Finding 1 (executor/ensemble tier) needs no further code; the merge path was always correct. The general code fix (item 2) ALSO protects durable static-provider executors via the durable-only-is-inert path, so any future static-provider durable brofile is covered.

RUNTIME VALIDATION ON PROD DAEMON (2026-05-31)

Rebuilt blackboxd release from fix/workflow-actor-tiering @ a986be6, swapped ~/.local/bin/blackboxd via rename, restarted launchd com.daystrom.blackbox (PID 42411 -> 80979, runs 5->6). Clean startup: "blackboxd listening on http://127.0.0.1:7264/mcp", workflows restored, no panic/bind errors.

FINDING 2 PROVEN LIVE. Dispatched the corpus-pathfinder scout (agent v2) on a trivial 'where' question. The INSTALLED brofile is still v3 (static provider:codex, NO runtime block) and the manifest carries an output schema -> dispatch forces StructuredOutput -> inert request. Result:
- Lease (allocator/leases.json) for task 5ed45910: provider=codex, model=gpt-5.5, tier=null, effort=medium, durable=false.
- bro_status: provider=codex, account=codex, transcript in ~/.codex/sessions/...; supervision ok; healthy multi-turn bbox graph walk.
Pre-fix this exact dispatch landed on claude-opus-4-8 (free-select). The code fix (pin_static_provider_if_inert seeding an artifact pin from the static provider on inert requests) resolves it to codex/gpt-5.5 end-to-end. Test task cancelled + pruned after proof.

STILL UNVALIDATED LIVE (optional):
- Finding 1: durable workflow executor / ensemble tier resolution under a real phase-decompose arc (premium brofiles -> premium-tier lane). Structurally correct + unit-tested; not yet exercised via a live durable dispatch.
- corpus-pathfinder v4 (runtime.pin) is NOT installed in the store yet — the live proof used v3 + the code fix, which is the stronger test of the general fix. Reinstalling v4 would add the belt-and-suspenders explicit pin.

Tier catalog changes also now live in prod (copilot mirrors codex, brodex across all tiers, vibe+deepseek-flash in drones, inception dropped, deepthink tier opt-in, premium opus->high).

FINDING 1 ROOT CAUSE CORRECTED + FIXED + LIVE-VALIDATED (2026-05-31)

My earlier "merge always correct, operational only" conclusion was WRONG. A live prod ensemble probe (minimal orchestrate_run dispatching phase-decomposer-panel) showed all 3 members resolving brodex/gpt-5.5/tier:NULL/durable — the original bug. Two real root causes:

1. STALE PROJECT-LOCAL BROFILES SHADOWING. resolve_brofile (src/orchestration/brofile.rs:215) prefers <project>/.bro/brofiles over the global store. The committed project-local phase-decompose/recompose brofiles in /repo/.bro/brofiles still had runtime:null. Commit 6ae3437 tiered system-defaults + the global install but missed these committed project-local copies. So brofile_runtime=None -> merge -> {durable:true, tier:null} -> free-select -> brodex (alphabetical tiebreak winner). FIX: synced canonical runtime block into all 10 project-local brofiles (premium; acceptance-advisor standard), preserving other fields. Copied to main worktree (daemon-read path) for live test.

2. workflow_dispatch_executor LACKED THE INERT-PIN SAFETY NET. pin_static_provider_if_inert was only wired into bro_agent_dispatch (agents.rs), not the workflow path. FIX: applied it in workflow_dispatch_executor (src/server/workflow_runtime.rs) after the brofile/actor merge — a request with no selection intent (durable-only) pins to the brofile's declared provider instead of free-selecting.

Committed c3f59b9 on fix/workflow-actor-tiering. Rebuilt + redeployed prod (pid 84187, runs=7).

LIVE RE-VALIDATION (post-deploy):
- inlet single executor: tier=premium, gpt-5.5/high (was the bug case).
- all 3 panel ensemble members: tier=premium, gpt-5.5/high (was tier:null brodex free-select).
Tier now propagates through both Finding 1 dispatch paths. Probe tasks pruned.

corpus-pathfinder v4 (operator pin) installed to global store; live scout lease confirmed codex/gpt-5.5/medium via explicit pin.

NEW OBSERVATION (separate decision, not a Finding 1 regression): with brodex now mapped into every tier and NO selection preference/weights/pool, premium (and all tiers) deterministically resolve to brodex — resolve_provider_pool sorts candidates by provider.as_str() and 'brodex' sorts first alphabetically, winning every tie. So every tiered durable actor converges to brodex/gpt-5.5. The phase-decomposer-panel's per-member static providers (claude/codex/deepseek) are ignored under tiering, collapsing panel provider-diversity. If diverse or claude-preferred premium lanes are wanted, set a selection_policy / provider preference / weights. Tier propagation itself is correct.

RESOLVED. All original open questions answered; both findings fixed and live-validated on prod; merged to main (FF, HEAD c3f59b9).

ANSWERS TO ORIGINAL OPEN QUESTIONS:
- Where brofile.runtime was dropped: ensemble/team-member + single-executor paths both went through workflow_dispatch_executor's merge (which was correct), but (a) stale committed project-local brofiles (/repo/.bro/brofiles, runtime:null) shadowed the tiered global install via resolve_brofile's project-first precedence, and (b) workflow_dispatch_executor lacked the inert-pin safety net. Both fixed.
- Allocator candidate source (brodex/copilot): resolve_provider_pool seeds Provider::ALL; no config file involved. Tier-less => full enum candidates => alphabetical tiebreak => brodex.
- Real fix: (a) tier threading now works (project-local brofiles tiered); (b) inert-pin seeding applied in BOTH agents.rs and workflow_runtime.rs; (c) corpus-pathfinder uses runtime.pin (v4, operator authority), installed global.
- Teams snapshot vs live: LIVE. The ensemble re-test picked up edited member brofiles without recreating the team — resolve_exec_brofile_for_allocator re-reads brofile files at each dispatch. No snapshot.

SHIPPED (main @ c3f59b9, 3 commits f57a515/a986be6/c3f59b9):
- pin_static_provider_if_inert + RuntimeRequest::expresses_selection_intent (allocator), wired into agents.rs AND workflow_runtime.rs.
- corpus-pathfinder v4 runtime.pin.
- 10 project-local phase-decompose/recompose brofiles tiered.
- Tier catalog: copilot mirrors codex, brodex across all tiers, vibe+deepseek-flash in drones, inception dropped, deepthink tier (opt-in), premium opus->high.
- Loop-closing allocator regression test.
Prod redeployed (pid 84187). Worktree + branch cleaned up.

FOLLOW-UP (separate, roadmapped): roadmap-96c1f8d3 "Allocator diversity-floor policy (rule-packet-backed)" — brodex wins every tier's alphabetical tiebreak, collapsing ensemble provider-diversity. Tier propagation is correct; default-selection tuning deferred to that item.
